## Names

<a id="scene0_colour_map"></a>
### [`scene0_colour_map`](../../../src/scene_colour_maps.asm#L6) `$6300-$64DF`

*data*

Colour RAM map of scene 0: 12 rows of 40 bytes. $19f6 copies it to $d8c8 (rows 5-16). Colour RAM keeps only the low nybble; the high nybbles vary like bytes read back from colour RAM.

- **Entry of:** [`scene_colour_map_ptrs`](../tables.md#scene_colour_map_ptrs)
